Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Slay the Spire, Ironclad run, Act 1 (observed). Mouse-driven UI.

CONTROLS / UI (observed unless noted):
- Coordinates are normalized (x = px/1280, y = px/720). Clicks must hit actual hitboxes; several early clicks landed above buttons because y was mis-estimated. Option rows on event/reward screens are ~0.70/0.775/0.85 vertically.
- Cards are played by DRAG from the card's center (hand cards sit at y ≈ 0.878–0.885) onto the target. Click-select-then-click-target does NOT work (Bash stayed in hand). Dragging onto empty field does not play Powers reliably; Powers (Inflame) resolve when dropped on the player sprite ~(0.255, 0.55). Drags starting off-card silently do nothing (energy unchanged) — always verify energy dropped after a play.
- Self-target cards (Defend) also need drop on player sprite; drop at (0.5,0.35) failed once.
- Card middle-of-screen animation: damage/effects sometimes apply only after the enlarged card display finishes; clicking empty space (e.g. ~0.5, 0.22–0.35) advances it. Sometimes damage appeared only on the following observation.
- End Turn button ≈ (0.851, 0.777). After clicking, button reads 'Enemy Turn' and cards fly to discard.
- Map: click a connected node, token moves; sometimes the first click only hovers, a repeat click at the same node registers. Then a black fade plays and the room loads. Map legend observed: ?=Unknown, Merchant, Treasure, Rest, Enemy, Elite.
- Loot/reward screens: rows ~y 0.387 (gold), 0.465–0.472 (potion), 0.54 (card); each must be clicked and its fly-in animation completed before the row clears. When list is empty a red 'Proceed' arrow appears ~(0.865, 0.69–0.694). 'Skip Rewards'/'Skip Gold'/'Skip Card' arrows sit to the right of rows.
- Event 'Leave' buttons ~y 0.85 (0.79 missed); sometimes two Leave clicks / extra dialogue page needed.
- Tip popups (e.g. Potions) have 'Got It' ~ (0.578, 0.647).
- Deck-view card removal: select card (row 1 centers ~x .224/.350/.475/.602/.729, y ≈ 0.396), then 'Confirm' at (0.935, 0.847).
- Combat enemy positions vary per fight; slime group at x ≈ .50/.576/.67/.762, y ≈ 0.61.

DECK / PROGRESS (observed):
- Started with 5 Strike, 4 Defend, Bash, plus Ascender's Bane curse appeared in deck/hand (unplayable; origin unknown).
- Cleric event: paid 50 gold for Purify, removed one Strike. Deck then 11.
- Added Inflame (Power, +2 Strength) after first fight; deck 12.
- Added Iron Wave (5 block + 5 damage) after Jaw Worm fight; deck 12/13.
- Added Sword Boomerang (3 damage ×3 random) from Louse fight reward; deck 13.
- Gold: 99 → 119 (loot) → 69 after Purify → +19 → 88 → +13 → 101. Potion: Energy Potion (Gain 2 Energy) in slot 1, unclaimed since.

RECORDED FIGHTS:
1) Single Louse/Jaw Worm, 43 HP, attack intents 12 then 7: Bash applied Vulnerable (2), Strikes chipped it down; damage numbers were lower than expected (Strike showed 6–9, Iron Wave showed 5). Won at 60→53→ then loot. Lesson: enemy block absorbs damage; Vulnerable increases damage but displayed values were inconsistent with card text — treat damage numbers as unreliable predictions.
2) Two Louses (11 HP atk 7, 16 HP atk 8): Louses gain ~8 block on first hit ('Curl Up'), so early chip is wasted. Played Inflame twice (Strength icon visible) but a later tooltip showed Strength only +2 — extra Inflame copies may not have applied or tooltip lags. Killed both; HP 45–56 range.
3) Elite (4 slimes, 11/15/13/9 HP, attacks 4–6 each; one green slime buffs then attacks): Current fight. Killed the 9-HP and 11-HP small slimes over two turns using Iron Wave and Strikes. Damage per Strike was 8 and Iron Wave 5 even with Strength claimed +6/+2 — strength application unclear. HP dropped 62 → 45 after taking ~13–18 unblocked. Leftover Defends used for block.

STATE AT CUTOFF (last observation): Elite fight, start/early of Player Turn 3. HP ~32 (expected after 13 damage; last confirmed 45 pre-enemy-turn), 3 energy refilled, hand being drawn; remaining enemies: two slimes ~15 HP and ~13 HP attacking 6 each, plus green slime ~13 HP also attacking 6. Block from prior Defend spent. Energy Potion still in slot 1.

ACTIVE GOALS / PLAN:
- Finish the Elite fight; prioritize killing one slime per turn to cut incoming damage. Use Energy Potion if a turn needs +2 energy to secure a kill.
- After combat, claim gold/potion/card rewards, then Proceed; map path above leads to a Rest site (observed icon up the left column).
- Consider using Rest to heal (HP low ~32/80) and the Energy Potion saved for the boss.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES / UNCERTAINTY:
- Whether Strength stacking from multiple Inflames actually accumulated (+6 icon vs +2 tooltip) — unverified.
- Why card damage numbers fall short of card text (enemy block, or display inconsistency).
- Whether Ascender's Bane was always in the deck or was added by a fight/event.
- Map coordinates shift as the map scrolls; re-read node positions each time rather than reusing old coordinates.
